motion_summary: Echion: white spiky hair, pale fierce face, black red costume, purple VF energy blade-arm. His R first enters VF rampage then unleashes uncontrolled VF forward. Animate idle blade down; lowering center of gravity; clutching charged arm; purple VF cracks surge; raising transformed arm; twisting torso back; heavy horizontal forward blade-arm slash; forward VF lance with serpent-like contour; recoil with bent knees; venting violet particles; arm lowers; exact idle returns. Preserve identity eye shape. Bright fuchsia/violet/white energy with dark crimson edges; no separate pet serpent and no gun.
